sentences.text:
Sri Milan Kumar Bhuti & Others vs The State Of West Bengal &
Others on 17 February, 2023
17.02.2023 Item no.12.
Court No.6.
Ab M.A.T. 1362 of 2022 Sri Milan Kumar Bhuti & Others Vs The State of West Bengal & Others Mr.
Amit Kr. Pan Mr. Tulsidas Roy .....for the Appellants.

Mr. Soumitra Bandopadhyay, Mr. Subhasis
Bandopadhyay ....for the State.
The Additional Land Acquisition Officer is present in Court today.
He has produced a copy of the relevant Award.
Hence, the contention of the appellants that no Award was ever declared, is not correct.

Mr. Pan, learned Advocate appearing for the appellants, however, says that his clients never received any compensation or notice of the Award as contemplated under Section 7(2)(aa)(ii) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition & Acquisition) Act, 1948.
List this matter once again on 20.2.2023 at 1.00 p.m.
On that date, the Additional Land Acquisition Officer shall produce notice of the Award if he can trace the same in the records.
